He is typing on a computer.] :[Gray message boxes with a small circled “x” at the top right corner are shown:] :Happy April 1st (observed)! :To celebrate, we were excited to introduce a new xkcd.com feature: push notifications for new comics! :Unfortunately, this feature has gone horribly wrong. :Until further notice, we are asking people ''NOT'' to sign up for new comic notifications. :Frankly, we recommend not even clicking on any notifications to learn more. :''Click this notification to learn more!'' (a circled arrow is shown) :“Push notifications for new comics” sounds like a simple feature, right? :There’s a nice API for browser notifications. xkcd updates three times a week. :So you just send a notification for each update, right? :That’s what we thought, too. :''Click to continue!'' (a circled arrow is shown) :[To the side of the comic frame is a big, horizontal hexagonal stop sign] :Sign: Emergency STOP :Below the sign: ''Halt ALL notifications and forget everything'' :The good news is that we did build a button to stop xkcd new comic notifications. :You can press this button at any time and the system will stop sending you notifications. :The nightmare will be over and the server will forget you ever existed. :This part definitely works. :''The rest of the system does NOT work.'' (a circled arrow is shown) :We’re sorry. :We don’t know how things went so wrong. :The system is sending more than three notifications a week. A LOT more. :We cannot recommend signing up for xkcd new comic notifications at this time. :''Click here to ignore the warnings.'' (a circled arrow is shown) :No, really. :Our notification system may send a large number of very real system notifications. :These may flood your browser, displace other notifications, and cause problems. :⚠️DO NOT ENABLE XKCD NEW COMIC NOTIFICATIONS⚠️ :''Yeah, I get it, but I definitely want to enable xkcd new comic notifications.'' (a circled arrow is shown) :Are you sure? :''Yes!'' (a circled arrow is shown) :Absolutely sure? :''YES!!'' (a circled arrow is shown) :To enable push notifications on mobile you need to add xkcd.com to your home screen. :''Click here to subscribe to xkcd notifications'' :[Initial static image shows Cueball sat on an office chair at a desk using a laptop computer. A notification 'window' is speech-bubbled above the computer] :[Grey notification box, header:] April 1st (Observed) :[Notification box, further text:] Open xkcd.com to view. :Laptop: [Warning sign.] :[When viewed live, various xkcd-style popover notifications appear, each can be dismissed or (usually the last on every page) invited to press an 'onwards'-style button.] :[First page of messages] :Happy April 1st! To celebrate, we were excited to introduce a new xkcd.com feature: Push Notifications for new comics! :Unfortunately, this feature has gone horribly wrong. :Until further notice, we are asking people NOT to sign up for new comic notifications. :Frankly, we recommend not even clicking on any notifications to learn more. :[Notification with 'onwards button':] ''Click on this notification to learn more'' :[Upon choosing to continue, further messages appear, replacing any prior ones left open] :"Push Notifications for new comics" sounds like a simple feature, right? :There's a nice API for browser notifications, xkcd updates three times a week. :So you just send a notification for each upafte, right? :That's what we thought, too. :[Notification with 'onwards button':] ''Click on this notification to continue'' :[Next set of popover messages] :The good news is that we did build a button to STOP xkcd new comic notifications. :You can press this button at any time and the system will stop sending you notifications. :The nightmare will be over and the server will forget you ever existed. :This part definitely works. :[Notification with 'onwards':] ''The rest of the system does not work.'' :[To the right of the comic frame, a red, octagonal button has white text upon it:]Emergency Stop :[Below the button is red text:] Halt all notifications and forget everything :[Next set of popovers, "stop" button remains permanently so long as you continue] :We're sorry. :We didn't know how things went so wrong. :The system is sending more than three notifications at this time. :['Onwards' notification:] ''Click here to ignore the warnings'' :[Next set.] :No, really. :Our notification system may send a large amount of very real system notifications. :These may flood your browser, displace other notifications, and cause problems. :[Text bookended by warning triangles:] Do not enable xkcd new comic notifications :['Onwards':] Yeah, I get it, but I definitely want to enable xkcd new comic notifications :[Just two popovers, initially] :Are you sure? :['Onwards':] Yes :[On clicking onwards, two more appear below] :Absolutely sure? :['Onwards':] Yes!! :[On clicking, a further popover] :[Red-tinted 'onwards'-style popover with warnings:] Click here to subscribe to xkcd notifications. :[...something appeared then dissappeared...] :[Genuine(?) browser dialogue activated:] xkcd.com wants to send you notifications. Block / Allow :[If allowed, one more popover in the original style] :Success!! :[Below the Emergency Stop button, an oval gray button appears labeled in white:] Silence notifications at a cost :[Below that, in grey text:]Temporarily pause your notifications at the cost of notifying two random people. :[Further changes include the contents of the comic.
